request.style: English, uplifting pop, bright female lead vocal with gang vocals on the chorus, piano, synth pads, electric guitar, driving drums, hand claps, joyful and festive, 118 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Down from the Mount of Olives on a borrowed colt he rides
No sword and no chariot, no soldiers at his side
The people throw their cloaks out on the dusty road ahead
They cut the branches from the trees and lay them down instead

[Pre-Chorus]
Say to the daughter of Zion
Look, your king is coming to you
Gentle and riding on a donkey

[Chorus]
Hosanna to the Son of David
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord
Hosanna in the highest
Hosanna in the highest

[Verse]
The city wakes and wonders and the question fills the air
Who is this that's riding in, who is this coming here
This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee
And save us now, we pray, is the cry from every street

[Pre-Chorus]
Say to the daughter of Zion
Look, your king is coming to you
Gentle and riding on a donkey

[Chorus]
Hosanna to the Son of David
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord
Hosanna in the highest
Hosanna in the highest

[Bridge]
Teacher, rebuke your disciples
I tell you, if they keep silent, the stones will cry out
Peace in heaven and glory in the highest

[Outro]
Hosanna to the Son of David
Hosanna in the highest
